independentValidation.method: Personally reread the native official image, all six month grids and the full colour legend. Independently transcribed each printed coloured run, then compared every date and relevant field with the prior JSON. No OCR or weekday rule used as source truth.
independentValidation.sourceImageDisplayLimit: Image tool displayed the 1638×2048 source at 1407×1760; all date numbers, colours and legend remained readable. Source file was not altered.
qualifications: Black is explicitly FERMÉ OU SUR RÉSERVATION. It cannot become unconditional closed.
The white background contains no day-status legend. Empty grid cells are outside that month, not closed days.
The July 11 pink concert marker gives neither opening nor closing time. Orange/blue hours from adjacent dates must not be carried over.
August 15 red: 10:30–22:00; activities close at 21:30, distinct from park closing.
Waterjump footer explicitly says opening Saturday June 20. No Waterjump end date or independent daily schedule is stated.
The FAQ states a general season April 18–September 27, 2026. The calendar still explicitly marks other April/September dates black: closed OR by reservation. Preserve both scopes.
No schedule before April 1 or after September 30 inferred. No 2027 dates published in the sources read.

conflicts.decision: Preserve the conflict. The news is specific to reopening; no source states it supersedes the calendar. Do not silently harmonize or infer a new general rule.
